summary: Implemented the rich_measure feature in the repository. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk with explicit iterator stack, 4 cells of indent per level) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width), adds Align.__repr__, and adds the public VerticalCenter class with render, measurement, and repr. rich/console.py passes justify="default" in collected render options while keeping the justify argument for collection. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added entry for rich_measure on tree and VerticalCenter. tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gained the requested imports and tests. Tests were not run, per instructions; all verification was by reading. Nothing was committed.
